subject: MAP kickoff: draft milestones, who owns what, and target close options
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Thompson <aisha.thompson@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + timeline options & stakeholder confirmation (post-discovery)

Hi Aisha — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking us through the Helix Health platform and the key constraints (data residency + low-latency inference in your West region). Per our call, attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and two timeline options so we can align on expectations and owners before a kickoff.

Attachment: 2027-04-04_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Quick recap from discovery:
- Primary objective: pilot Redwood inference for on-prem patient summary generation (throughput target ~150 req/min, median p95 latency < 350ms).
- Must remain within Helix VPC for PHI; SOC 2 evidence required.
- Decision stakeholders: Security, IT Ops, Procurement, and Product.

Proposed MAP highlights (see attached for full table):
1) Aggressive path (Option A) — 6 weeks to POC:
   - Week 1: Kickoff + env access (Helix IT)
   - Week 2–3: Model onboarding + integration (Redwood eng)
   - Week 4: Performance tuning + trials (joint)
   - Week 5: Security review + remediation
   - Week 6: POC sign-off
   Owners: Helix IT (access), Helix Security (approval), Redwood Eng (integration).

2) Standard path (Option B) — 12 weeks to production pilot (recommended if you need procurement/legal windows):
   - Milestones spaced to allow compliance and procurement reviews.

Dependencies: network egress rules, KMS access for keys, SOC 2 artifacts, and temporary access credentials for a staging VPC.

Asks / next steps: Could you confirm (by reply):
- Which timeline you prefer (A or B)?
- The list of Helix stakeholders we should include on the kickoff (name + email + role).
- Any hard constraints for target close date (e.g., budget window, board timelines).

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week to lock owners and the POC scope — I’m free Tue/Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
https://www.redwood.com
From: Aisha Thompson <aisha.thompson@helixhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@helixhealth.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + timeline options & stakeholder confirmation (post-discovery)

Thanks, Irene — good summary and thanks to Karthik and Marissa for joining too.

Quick responses: we prefer the Standard path (Option B) given our internal procurement and security windows. High-level stakeholders (please add to the thread):
- Mark Rivera (IT Ops) — mark.rivera@helixhealth.com — will own environment access and network changes.
- Lena Ortiz (Security) — lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com — will run the SOC 2/PII review and sign-off.
- Procurement — procurement@helixhealth.com — will handle contract and SOW review.
- Product: Aisha Thompson (me) — will act as internal PM for the pilot.

Question for Redwood: can you provide a ballpark cost range for a 3-month pilot (approx throughput above) and confirm what SOC 2 artifacts you will share and when? Procurement will want ballpark pricing to start the budgeting conversation.

We can do a kickoff the week of Apr 12; Tue 4/13 10–11am PT or Thu 4/15 2–3pm PT both work for key folks.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Thompson
Sr. Product Manager | Helix Health
aisha.thompson@helixhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Thompson <aisha.thompson@helixhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + timeline options & stakeholder confirmation (post-discovery)

Aisha — great, thanks for the quick reply and for listing stakeholders. I pushed an updated MAP (v1.1) with a slightly adjusted milestone cadence for the Standard path and a preliminary cost ballpark for a 3-month pilot (est. $18k–$25k depending on sustained throughput and any dedicated capacity needs).

Attachment: 2027-04-05_MAP_Draft_v1.1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

High-level changes in v1.1:
- Added a gating checklist for Security (SOC 2 artifact handoff at Week 2) and Procurement (SOW review window Weeks 3–6).
- Responsibility matrix: Redwood Eng (integration + tuning), Helix IT (VPC access + firewall), Helix Security (artifact review + approval), Helix Procurement (contract turnaround).
- Proposed target close / pilot sign-off: 2027-06-07 if we start the Standard path the week of Apr 12.

Pending items for kickoff:
- Helix to confirm network owner and provide a temporary staging VPC CIDR (Mark).
- Helix Security to confirm which SOC 2 artifacts they require beyond the standard report (Lena).
- Procurement to confirm preferred contract template and any special clauses (Procurement).

Irene / Karthik are available for a 30-minute kickoff on 2027-04-13 at 10:00am PT — I can send a calendar invite once Aisha confirms. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HLX-2027-042

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + timeline options & stakeholder confirmation (post-discovery)

Thanks all — procurement here. We reviewed the v1.1 draft and will start an internal SOW review this week. A few items we need from Redwood to move faster:
- A short pilot SOW template or a redlineable Word version.
- A summary of the security artifacts you will provide (SOC 2 report, incident response contacts, data handling matrix).

We are comfortable with the proposed kickoff on 2027-04-13 10:00am PT — please send an invite. Also sending this loop to our legal lead for quick review; we expect a 2–3 week contract feedback window once we have a draft SOW.

Procurement will accept DocuSign for signature. You can upload contracts here: https://docusign.example.com/records/ABC123

Procurement Team
